description: Create remaining templates and sections: page, blog, article, search, 404, and gift card. Add password page template. Finalize theme with complete settings_data.json preset, final CSS polish, and ensure all files are ready for Shopify upload.
steps: Create sections/main-page.liquid with: page title, page content from page.content. Schema settings: show_title checkbox, content_width select (narrow/full).

Create sections/main-blog.liquid with: blog title, article cards grid (featured image, title, excerpt, date, author, read more link), pagination. Schema settings: articles_per_page range, show_author checkbox, show_date checkbox, show_featured_image checkbox.

Create sections/main-article.liquid with: article title, featured image, author/date byline, article content, tags, social share buttons, comment form if comments enabled, previous/next navigation. Schema settings: show_author checkbox, show_date checkbox, show_share_buttons checkbox, show_tags checkbox.

Create sections/main-search.liquid with: search form, results count, product results grid using product-card snippet, page/article results list, pagination. Schema settings: show_products checkbox, show_pages checkbox, show_articles checkbox, results_per_page range.

Create sections/main-404.liquid with: 404 message, search form, continue shopping button, optional featured products. Schema settings: heading text, message text, show_search checkbox, show_products checkbox, collection collection picker.
Create templates/gift_card.liquid as Liquid template (not JSON) with: gift card image, code display with copy button, balance, QR code using gift_card object, print button.
Create layout/password.liquid with: simplified layout for password page (no header nav, just logo).
Create templates/password.json with section for password form and store opening message.

Create sections/main-password.liquid with: store logo, coming soon message, password form, email signup for launch notification. Schema settings: heading text, message richtext, show_email_signup checkbox.

Update config/settings_data.json with complete 'current' preset: all color values matching spiritual theme (#FF6B00 primary, #8B0000 secondary, #D4AF37 accent, #FFF8F0 background), typography selections, social media placeholder URLs, and comprehensive section configurations for index.json preview.

Review and finalize assets/theme.css: ensure all components have complete styles, add print styles, verify responsive breakpoints at 768px and 1024px, add focus states for accessibility, confirm color variables use theme settings.
Review and finalize assets/theme.js: ensure no console errors, add error handling, verify all interactive elements work (menus, tabs, sliders, forms).
Create snippets/breadcrumb.liquid for breadcrumb navigation on product/collection/article pages.
Add breadcrumb rendering to main-product, main-collection, main-article sections.
acceptance_criteria: templates/page.json, templates/blog.json, templates/article.json exist with valid JSON
templates/search.json renders search results using search object
templates/gift_card.liquid renders gift card details with QR code
config/settings_data.json has complete 'current' object with all theme settings populated
All CSS and JS files are finalized with no missing styles or broken interactions
Theme directory contains all required files for Shopify upload
verification: Validate all new JSON template files have valid syntax
Check templates/gift_card.liquid contains {{ gift_card.code }} and QR code rendering
Verify settings_data.json 'current' object has keys matching all settings_schema.json settings
Run JSON validation on all files in config/ directory
List all files in theme directory to confirm complete structure: layout/, config/, templates/, templates/customers/, sections/, snippets/, assets/, locales/
findings: All FEAT-005 requirements implemented successfully. Created: sections/main-page.liquid, sections/main-blog.liquid, sections/main-article.liquid, sections/main-search.liquid, sections/main-404.liquid, sections/main-password.liquid, templates/page.json, templates/blog.json, templates/article.json, templates/search.json, templates/404.json, templates/password.json, templates/gift_card.liquid, layout/password.liquid, snippets/breadcrumb.liquid. Updated settings_data.json with complete preset. Added breadcrumb to main-product and main-collection sections. Updated locales/en.default.json with new translation keys. All JSON files validated successfully. Theme structure complete with all required directories.
